title: Compressed OSCORE round-trip
notes:
BLOCKED 2026-08-26 Phase-2 audit (no claim, no source edits): prerequisite project-LICHEN-worker6-l1qw.12.3.1 (Rule 5 compression) remains open. More importantly, project-LICHEN-worker6-jftb is still in_progress for a correctness defect in the Rust Rule 5 matcher: it accepts fe80::/10 while decompression reconstructs fe80::/64, so valid non-/64 link-local packets can be silently changed and an end-to-end compressed OSCORE round-trip cannot yet be certified. Canonical Rules 5/6 packet-level vectors are independently verified by closed sibling 12.3.3, but repository search found only separate OSCORE protect/unprotect tests and separate SCHC compress/decompress tests—not a production OSCORE -> IPv6/UDP/CoAP -> Rule 5 -> restore -> OSCORE integration consumer. Exact integration targets are also shared dirty (python/src/lichen/crypto/oscore.py, python/src/lichen/schc/headers.py, rust/lichen-oscore/**, rust/lichen-schc/src/codec.rs, OSCORE/SCHC tests/vectors). Current sibling agents reported no active edits, but the unresolved claimed jftb lane owns the necessary Rule 5 correction. Closed vector sibling also records an excluded Zephyr/C Rule 6 mismatch (C test uses fd00:: instead of the specified 0200::/8). Leave this bead open/unassigned until Rule 5 correctness lands, then add an independent Python/Rust cross-layer integration test using production consumers.
Implemented the missing production cross-layer interop harness without changing OSCORE/SCHC production codecs. Added format-v2 oscore_schc_roundtrip.json plus an independent generator that consumes byte-identical Python/Rust OSCORE outputs and manually encodes IPv6/UDP/CoAP and Rule 5, never importing production SCHC. Added Python, Rust, and isolated Zephyr consumers exercising protect -> exact Rule 5 compress -> exact decompress -> unprotect. Coverage includes distinct sender/recipient IDs, sender sequences 0 and 42, maximum 40-bit sequence accepted once then exhaustion, replay, ciphertext corruption, truncation, wrong secret/context, noncanonical SCHC padding, output failure atomicity, and successful delivery after failed authentication proving replay state was not advanced. Validation: Python focused OSCORE/SCHC suites 30 passed and ruff clean; Rust integration 3/3, rustfmt scoped clean, clippy -D warnings clean, no-default-features check clean; local Zephyr 4.1 qemu_x86 build and runtime 3/3 PASS using the approved verification-only -Wno-error=duplicated-branches suppression for unrelated logging macros. Scoped diff --check clean. Pinned local Zephyr 3.7 tree remains unavailable per AGENTS.
close_reason: Cross-language OSCORE protect/compress/decompress/unprotect integration and failure-state acceptance implemented and green in Python, Rust, and Zephyr.
